clicksync canonical fresh UTxO-flow dataset contract

This descriptor is the immutable content identity of a freshly created
dataset. Any semantic change below requires a new hash. There is no in-place
upgrade path: a dataset whose stored hash differs must fail closed.

dataset_manifest is an append-only MergeTree ordered by
(manifest_key, revision), with index_granularity 64 and a client-verified
previous-row/row-digest chain. Its bounded singleton head carries immutable
dataset, mainnet genesis, start, and contract identity; physical, effective,
servable-floor, checked, and last-agreed event-points; trust basis/status;
visibility generation; and crash-recoverable pending operations.

Peer-derived trust evidence has a unique check ID plus stable agreement group
and increasing attempt. Eligible peer_observations receive contiguous,
writer-assigned evidence_ordinal values and are ordered by
(check_id, evidence_ordinal, observation_id). A logical-ID projection is
ordered by (check_id, observation_id, evidence_ordinal). Each logical ordinal
permits at most eight byte-identical physical replays; conflicts, ordinal
gaps, duplicate logical IDs, and a ninth replay fail closed. The evidence
commitment is SHA-256 over the domain separator and each canonical
(big-endian ordinal, observation ID, observation digest) tuple.

Evidence admission is manifest-authorized and append-only. An open check
records committed prefix count/digest C. Before inserting the next row, the
manifest reserves its canonical payload, digest, writer, and ordinal. Startup
accepts only exact C or exact C+the reserved tuple, proves the old prefix
digest, replays the reserved row idempotently, then commits the new
count/digest. Finalization freezes the commitment before evaluation.

Every observation persists its proof method. source_change diagnostics use
none, ordinal zero, unavailable/quarantined result, and no verification/source
flags. chain_sync_singleton and paired_chain_sync_singleton agreements prove
only exact point membership; failed attempts carry no proof flags.
boundary_singleton_block_fetch agreements prove point and body, with selected
source true only for the actual publication source. follow_block_fetch
agreements prove selected source, point, and body. Parent proof is always
false until a producer explicitly proves it. disagreement rows never agree.

LastAgreedEvidence is a durable reference to the exact check/group/attempt,
threshold, confirmed count, checked event-point, and frozen evidence
count/digest that authorized LastAgreed. Starting another check cannot erase
that authority. A permanent official-genesis exception uses the physical
synthetic-genesis Origin event as both servable floor and LastAgreed, not
event zero.

A pending rollback retains its exact identity, target, old physical head,
depth, observer arrays, check/group/attempt/checked event, threshold, writer,
and frozen evidence count/digest. The physical rollback header repeats the
same evidence count/digest. Reservation freezes C before invalidations;
recovery and finalization re-evaluate exactly C, and final LastAgreedEvidence
retains C after pending state is cleared. Ordinary reconciliation cannot adopt
rollback headers or invalidations.

blocks, transactions, inputs, outputs, datum_bodies, datum_observations,
withdrawals, redeemers, and transaction_metadata are immutable physical facts.
chain_events and rollbacks are append-only canonical membership events.
writer_audit is operational history and is not writer authority.

Visibility is the manifest effective event snapshot minus append-only,
header-authorized invalidations. Raw transaction/block CBOR, script bodies,
certificates, governance actions, votes, and proposals are outside this
dataset.

Trust sampling occurs every 512 primary blocks. A primary-only physical suffix
may contain at most 767 blocks and remains anchored to retained sampled-peer or
official-genesis authority. checking and disputed states clamp visibility.
Availability and range failures retry indefinitely with capped per-attempt
backoff and context cancellation; only deterministic peer-data/correctness
violations quarantine.
